newsitem.title: CANADA: CRICKET-INDIA WINS TOSS, SENDS PAKISTAN IN TO BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA WINS TOSS, SENDS PAKISTAN IN TO BAT.

text.p: India won the toss and opted to send Pakistan in to bat in the first of five limited over cricket matches for the Sahara Cup at the Toronto Cricket, Skating and Curling Ground on Monday.
The damp ground prevented play from starting on time Monday morning.
Umpires inspected the wicket at noon local time and ordered play start one hour later. The match was reduced to 33 overs a side.
Two matches at the weekend were washed out by rain and showers were predicted for later Monday.
All rounder Wasim Akram will lead a full strength Pakistan team into the match against Sachin Tendulkar's Indian side.
Pakistan - Aamir Sohail, Saeed Anwar, Ijaz Ahmed, Inzamam- ul-Haq, Shahdab Kabir, Saleem Malik, Wasim Akram (c) Moin Khan, Saqlain Mushtaq, Azhar Mahmood, Waqar Younis.
India - Sachin Tendulkar (c), Ajay Jadeja, Mohammad Azharuddin, Sourav Ganguly, Rahul Dravid, Vinod Kambli, Sunil Joshi, Nayan Mongia, Anil Kumble, Javagal Srinath, B.K. Venkatesh Prasad.
